name: Shifting Fortune
body:
School divination; Level bloodrager 1, inquisitor 1, magus 1, psychic 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous, see text
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You shift the fortunes of the target creature and give them to another. You may cast this spell on a target that had just succeeded on an attack roll, ability check, caster level check, skill check or saving throw. The target must make a Will save or be forced to reroll the check and use the lower roll.

You can then choose a different creature, including yourself to get the target’s good fortune for 1 minute. If the benefiting creature rolls the same check as the original target, they can roll that check twice and take the higher result. Once this ability is used on a check, the spell ends.

A creature can only benefit from one casting of this spell at a time.
